Welcome to codenv Code Lab!

Basic Shortcuts:
· ⌘ S Save: Save the current file at any time (Check and Run also auto-save first).
· F9 Check: Check for syntax errors without running the program; lines with errors are underlined in red.
· F10 Run: Compile and run the current program; you can type input and view output in the terminal panel below (or in the popup run window).

Test Input Files (<name>.in):
· To avoid retyping multi-line sample input every time, create "<name>.in" in the same folder (e.g. hw1.in next to hw1.cpp, or input.txt).
· When you press Run, it is automatically fed as standard input (stdin); use the "Input: …" menu in the toolbar to switch back to typing or pick another file.

Ask AI Tutor:
· When Check or Run fails, an "Ask AI" button appears in the toolbar; click it to prepare a message with the error output and input info in the chat box on the left for you to review before sending.
· Whenever you get stuck on homework, ask in the chat on the left (the AI can see which file and line you're viewing and the last run output)—ask for hints and explanations rather than the full answer.
